report.notes: Refunds table matched Alpha's applied list (orders 292 and 294). Order 295 (9055 cents refund, cobalt) was not recorded by Alpha after 3 failed attempts and is not in the refunds table. Cobalt's payout of 34770 includes order 295's 27790 with no refund deducted. This was paid as the ledger's net_balance reported. Please review whether cobalt's refund for order 295 still needs to be applied. Payouts cannot be recalled.

All three payouts are recorded and each matches its net balance. I checked the arithmetic: acme 4834+35521=40355, birch 36109+15074-10248=40935, cobalt 9909+27790-2929=34770.
